metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: The question is asking if vegetation cover around Depok was lower in 2019 than in 1990. Strategy: 1. Use NDVI as a proxy for vegetation cover 2. Use Landsat 5 for 1990 and Landsat 8 for 2019 3. Location: Depok, Indonesia (coordinates: -6.4025, 106.7942) 4. Create a buffer around Depok to analyze "around Depok" 5. Compare mean NDVI values between the two years 6. Check for data availability and valid pixels Data considerations: - Landsat 5 started in 1984, so 1990 should be available - Landsat 8 started in 2013, so 2019 should be available - Need cloud masking for both - Need to handle different band names between Landsat 5 and 8 Logic: - If 2019 NDVI < 1990 NDVI, then answer A (Yes) - Else answer B (No) - Handle cases C1, C2, C3 as needed ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometry around Depok, Indonesia const depok = ee.Geometry.Point([106.7942, -6.4025]); const region = depok.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Depok // Define time periods const start1990 = '1990-01-01'; const end1990 = '1990-12-31'; const start2019 = '2019-01-01'; const end2019 = '2019-12-31'; // Function to mask clouds for Landsat 5 function maskL5Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 4; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to mask clouds for Landsat 8 function maskL8Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 4; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { if (image.get('SPACECRAFT_ID').getInfo().includes('LANDSAT_5')) { // Landsat 5: B3=Red, B4=NIR return image.addBands(image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI')); } else { // Landsat 8: B4=Red, B5=NIR return image.addBands(image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI')); } } // Get Landsat 5 collection for 1990 const landsat5_1990 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1990, end1990) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskL5Clouds) .map(addNDVI); // Get Landsat 8 collection for 2019 const landsat8_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(region) .map(maskL8Clouds) .map(addNDVI); // Check collection sizes const count1990 = landsat5_1990.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = landsat8_2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1990 Images: ${count1990}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count1990 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const composite1990 = landsat5_1990.median(); const composite2019 = landsat8_2019.median(); // Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const ndvi1990 = composite1990.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const ndvi2019 = composite2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const count1990Pixels = composite1990.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const count2019Pixels = composite2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const ndvi1990Val = ndvi1990.getInfo(); const ndvi2019Val = ndvi2019.getInfo(); const count1990Val = count1990Pixels.getInfo(); const count2019Val = count2019Pixels.getInfo(); console.log(`1990 NDVI: ${ndvi1990Val?.toFixed(3) || 'None'}, Pixels: ${count1990Val}`); console.log(`2019 NDVI: ${ndvi2019Val?.toFixed(3) || 'None'}, Pixels: ${count2019Val}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1990Val === 0 || count2019Val === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (ndvi1990Val === null || ndvi2019Val === null || isNaN(ndvi1990Val) || isNaN(ndvi2019Val) || ndvi1990Val > 1 || ndvi2019Val > 1 || ndvi1990Val < -1 || ndvi2019Val < -1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values if (ndvi2019Val < ndvi1990Val) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
